Cite: Bitdepth · bitdepth.dev/m/mimo-v2.6-pro · as of Nov 11, 2026

Reference: plurality across all endpoints (fewer than two declare bf16 or fp16). Open the MiMo V2.6 Pro page.

Method

How this board is measured.

The reference

For each model, the answer most endpoints declaring full precision (bf16 or fp16) give at temperature zero. Where fewer than two declare it, the plurality answer across all endpoints. Method.

Agreement and self-agreement

Agreement is how often an endpoint gives the reference answer. Self-agreement is how often it gives its own answer twice. An endpoint that agrees with itself far more than with the reference is serving something different.

How rank works

Endpoints that match the reference are ranked by quality-adjusted price: the blended price, (3 × input + output) ÷ 4 per million tokens, divided by agreement. A cheap endpoint that misses the reference is never shown as the cheapest.

First look

An endpoint needs 7 nights before it is ranked. Until then it shows its night count and its numbers, with no rank.

Drift

The mean of the last three nights against the first three. A move of more than 10 points reads as improving or worsening; anything smaller is stable.

How to cite

Every chart and table carries a cite line with the date. Copy it with the figure. Wrong model name or missing endpoint? Tell us.

Get the data

The same figures as JSON, one file per model, rewritten every night.
